work_experience.description: Supported test planning by reviewing requirements, workflows, validation rules, business rules, and API specifications; designed and maintained structured scenarios and detailed cases with positive, negative, and edge-case coverage, evidence, reports, and release documentation. Executed manual functional, regression, system integration, UI/web, desktop POS, iPad POS, smoke, exploratory, and release-validation tests across demo and live environments, covering role-based access, synchronization, validation, workflow, and error-handling paths. Tested REST APIs and JSON responses with Postman; performed basic SQL/PostgreSQL data verification, front-end/back-end synchronization checks, Shopify product and order-flow validation, and REST-to-GraphQL checks across integrated POS and dashboard modules. Reproduced, logged, tracked, retested, and verified Jira defects through resolution with clear steps, expected and actual results, evidence, and impact notes; collaborated with developers and QA team members to confirm fixes.
